items.title: Critical Erlang/OTP Flaw Could Let Hackers Impersonate TLS Servers and Intercept Encrypted Traffic
items.description: A critical Erlang/OTP flaw, CVE-2026-124286 (CVSS 9.1), disclosed on November 24, 2026, allows attackers to impersonate trusted servers and intercept or modify TLS-protected traffic. The flaw affects TLS 1.2 clients, even those with server identity verification enabled, but does not impact TLS 1.3 connections. During the TLS handshake, clients use server certificates to verify the […] The post…

items.title: Kenya eCitizen Data Breach – Hackers Reportedly Leak Identity Records of 32 Million Kenyans
items.description: Hackers have reportedly begun publishing identity records from Kenya’s eCitizen platform on the dark web. Nation’s review of the leaked eCitizen files found that the attackers had accessed data on 32,128,394 Kenyans. The figure reflects the reported scale of access. It does not mean every record has been published, and Kenyan authorities have not confirmed […] The post Kenya eCitizen Data Breach…

items.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach
items.description: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department. [...]

items.title: Your Firewall Isn't Enough: The Hidden Risk of Unmanaged VMs
items.description: Forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and excessive access permissions can create security blind spots across IT infrastructure. ISPsystem explains how centralized infrastructure management, access controls, and resource lifecycle automation can help reduce these risks. [...]

When a service technician tried to sign in to the cooling control system, his access was blocked. items.title: 12-Year-Old NFS2ROOT Linux Flaw Let Hackers Take Full Control of Servers Without a Password
items.description: A critical Linux kernel flaw called NFS2ROOT could let an attacker take full control of an unpatched Network File System (NFS) server without logging in. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-99362, affects the Linux kernel’s NFS server when NFSv4.1 or NFSv4.2 is enabled and an attacker can reach TCP port 2049. items.description: Attackers could have disrupted traveler entry into Nigeria, Ethiopia, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Fiji, and Ghana via several vulnerabilities in their online visa and immigration systems.
